item.title: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria linked to severe stomach illness across US
item.summary: A CDC alert warns that drug-resistant Shigella infections have increased substantially in the U.S., with cases spreading domestically since 2011.

item.title: Satellite images may have tipped off Iran before US base attack, top Republican warns
item.summary: House China Committee chairman says commercial satellite imagery may have been used as targeting data ahead of an Iranian strike on a U.S. air base.

item.title: 'DoorDash Grandma' slams paid actor rumors after delivering to President Trump at the White House
item.summary: DoorDash driver Sharon Simmons denied being a paid actor after delivering to President Donald Trump at the White House to mark the "no tax on tips" policy anniversary.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Swalwell accusers detail experiences with lawmaker after he announces his resignation from Congress
item.summary: Two women accusing Rep. Eric Swalwell of sexual misconduct spoke out on "CBS Mornings" on Tuesday, detailing alleged explicit messages and hotel invitations from the lawmaker.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Swalwell out amid sexual assault allegations after 13 years in Congress
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell, D-Calif., resigned Tuesday as sexual misconduct allegations mounted and calls for his removal intensified.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] College football player, 20, killed in motorcycle crash while riding on interstate
item.summary: Kelvin Broadhurst Jr., a 20-year-old North Carolina A&T football player, died in a motorcycle crash in Greensboro after being ejected from his bike.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Trump swings for Moon with nuclear reactor plans as China, Russia team up in space race
item.summary: The Trump administration released a memo detailing plans for a nuclear reactor on the Moon by 2030 to advance U.S. space exploration and defense.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Dianna Russini resigns from The Athletic amid Mike Vrabel controversy
item.summary: NFL reporter Dianna Russini resigned from The Athletic on Tuesday amid mounting criticism over her relationship with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel, which came under fire last week after the two were photographed together at an exclusive resort in Arizona.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Weight gain in certain decade of life may be more dangerous, study suggests
item.summary: A study of over 620,000 people found that weight gain in your 20s carries disproportionately high and lasting risks of premature death later in life.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] ICE lodges detainer for illegal migrant charged with strangling wife and dumping body near Oklahoma highway
item.summary: An illegal migrant in Tulsa County, Oklahoma, is charged with murder for allegedly strangling his wife. DHS and ICE have lodged a detainer request.
